latest.title: 🚀 Mastering the Production Crunch: Deploying a Multi-Service AI WAFR Agent on AWS Fargate
latest.description: This log details the tense, one-day production deployment of an AI-powered AWS WAFR platform. Orchestrated via 13 AWS CDK CloudFormation stacks, the multi-service architecture integrates a security scanner, GenAI, a graph database, PostgreSQL, Redis, and React. A routine launch became a 6-hour troubleshooting marathon, exposing 9 critical failures across container networking, configuration, Lambda packaging, and AI integration. It offers the engineering community an unfiltered, battle-tested post-mortem.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
